tagline: Watches your mailboxes — and notices the mail that never arrives.
scaffold_notice: This is the v1 scaffold: the four services are wired up, the dashboard follows with the UI milestone.
autotask_intro: Nightwatch opens a ticket for the right company when a monitor breaks, comments on escalation and all-clear, and closes the ticket again when the recovery is evidence-based and nobody has touched it. Every numeric ID below is specific to your Autotask database and is resolved here rather than guessed.
autotask_access_hint: Create a dedicated API-only user in Autotask with a custom (internal) integration code. It needs no UI access — only permission to read and write tickets and to read companies.
autotask_user_hint: The email address of the API-only user. Changing it clears the stored zone — a different user can mean a different Autotask database, so the zone has to be resolved again.
autotask_secret_hint: Stored AES-256-GCM encrypted and never shown again.
autotask_code_hint: The tracking identifier of the API user; custom (internal integration) for a self-hosted Nightwatch.
autotask_channel_hint: Off means nothing is sent. Customers without a link stay on dashboard and webhook either way.
autotask_zone_hint: The API base URL differs per Autotask database. It is resolved once and then stored.
autotask_zone_failed: The zone could not be resolved. Check the API user name.
autotask_zone_needs_user: Save the API user name first.
autotask_ready: Ready — tickets will be opened for linked customers.
autotask_not_ready: Not ready yet. Access, zone, status, priority, note type and note visibility are all required — an all-clear is a note, so without the note fields Nightwatch could open tickets it can never comment on or close.
autotask_defaults_hint: Resolved from your Autotask picklists. Status and priority are mandatory for every ticket; the rest depends on your ticket category and tenant settings.
autotask_picklists_failed: The picklists could not be loaded from Autotask, so the IDs have to be entered as numbers. Check the access above.
autotask_status_hint: Also the reference for “untouched”: a ticket is only closed automatically while it is still in this status.
autotask_queue_hint: Required by some ticket categories, e.g. a triage queue.
autotask_close_status_hint: Used only for an evidence-based all-clear on an untouched ticket. Leave empty to never close automatically.
autotask_work_type_hint: Only needed if your tenant requires a work type on tickets.
autotask_note_type_hint: Used for every comment Nightwatch writes.
autotask_note_publish_hint: Who gets to see the comments.
autotask_due_hours_hint: Autotask requires a due date unless your ticket category supplies one. Leave empty to omit the field.
autotask_save_failed: Could not be saved. NIGHTWATCH_SECRET_KEY may not be set.
webhooks_intro: Nightwatch calls every active receiver on alarm, escalation and all-clear. The payload is self-carrying — monitor, customer, reason, times and a link back — so a receiver never has to ask Nightwatch anything. Delivery is at-least-once with backoff: the same event can arrive twice, and the receiver tells the repeat by alert_id and event.
webhooks_signature_hint: Every call carries X-Nightwatch-Signature, an HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body with this receiver's secret. docs/webhook.md documents the payload and shows how to verify it.
webhook_url_hint: HTTPS only. Plain HTTP needs the opt-in below and is meant for receivers inside your own network.
webhook_http_optin: Allow plain HTTP for this receiver
webhook_http_optin_hint: Without TLS the payload and its signature travel readable on the wire. Only for an internal receiver that has no certificate.
webhook_secret_hint: Used for the HMAC. Stored AES-256-GCM encrypted and never shown again.
webhook_secret_kept: Stored — leave empty to keep it, fill in to replace it.
webhook_secret_missing: No signing secret — deliveries to this receiver fail
webhook_remove_confirm: Remove this receiver? It stops getting alarms.
webhook_remove_blocked: This receiver cannot be removed while deliveries still refer to it — that record is the evidence of which alarms failed to reach it. Switch it off instead.
webhook_save_failed: Could not be saved. NIGHTWATCH_SECRET_KEY may not be set.
mailboxes_intro: Nightwatch polls each mailbox's inbox via the Microsoft Graph delta query. Connecting one pulls a one-off learning window of past mail — learning material for rule derivation and mail search, never monitoring material.
mailbox_label_hint: Shown on the dashboard, e.g. “NOC inbox”.
mailbox_client_hint: Your multi-tenant app registration; the same ID for every customer.
mailbox_secret_hint: Stored AES-256-GCM encrypted and never shown again.
mailbox_secret_expiry_hint: Optional. Drives the warning before ingestion silently stops.
mailbox_learning_window_hint: How much history the one-off backfill fetches. 1 to 90 days.
mailbox_backfill_running: Learning window is still being fetched
mailbox_remove_confirm: Remove this mailbox? Its mails and delta state are deleted; alarm history and ticket correlations are kept.
onboarding_consent_hint: Send this link to an administrator of the customer tenant. It grants the application permission Mail.Read.
onboarding_redirect_hint: Register this redirect URI in your app registration first — Microsoft Entra ID matches it character for character:
onboarding_rbac_hint: Without this, the consent grants access to every mailbox in the customer tenant. Run this in Exchange Online PowerShell.
consent_granted: Consent was granted. Permissions can take up to two hours to take effect.
customers_intro: Every incoming mail is assigned to a customer first and only then to that customer's monitors. Without a matching assignment trait it goes to the system triage — there is deliberately no catch-all customer.
customer_number_hint: Master data only. To actually assign by it, add it as a stage ② trait as well.
customer_autotask_hint: Optional. Search the Autotask directory and pick the company once — only its stable ID is stored, there is no continuous sync. Without a link the customer is alerted via dashboard and webhook only.
customer_autotask_none: Not linked — alarms for this customer go to the dashboard and webhooks only.
customer_autotask_name_unknown: Autotask does not know this ID (any more).
customer_autotask_unconfigured: Autotask is not configured yet — set up access in the settings first.
customer_archive_confirm: Archive this customer? Their monitors stop being evaluated and open disruptions end silently, without an all-clear. The assignment traits keep matching, so residual mail is filed silently instead of flooding the triage.
customer_delete_hint: For mistaken entries only: as soon as a mail, a monitor or a mail kind is attached, archiving is the only option left.
customer_delete_confirm: Delete this customer permanently? Only possible for a mistaken entry without history, and it cannot be undone.
customer_delete_blocked: This customer already has history and can only be archived.
customer_unknown: This customer does not exist (any more).
traits_intro: Fixed priority ①②③: the highest matching stage wins immediately, nothing is weighted. If several customers match on the same stage the mail goes to the system triage rather than being guessed at.
traits_empty: No trait yet — no mail can currently be assigned to this customer.
trait_collision_hint: It is saved anyway — transition phases need that. While both exist, a matching mail becomes ambiguous and lands in the system triage.
stage_plus_adresse_hint: The tagged address handed out by you, e.g. noc+customera@msp.example — deterministic, hence the highest priority.
stage_inhaltsmuster_hint: Text appearing in the mail's subject or body, e.g. a customer number. Case-insensitive; matched as a whole token, so K-1234 does not catch K-12345.
stage_absender_hint: Sender address or domain, e.g. reports@acme.example or acme.example. Subdomains do not count.
error_trait_plus_address: Enter a plus address with a tag, e.g. noc+customera@msp.example.
error_trait_too_short: At least three characters — shorter patterns match almost every mail.
error_trait_sender: Enter a sender address or a domain.
error_trait_duplicate: This customer already has this trait.
error_autotask_search: Autotask could not be searched. Check the access in the settings.
error_webhook_url: Enter a complete URL, e.g. https://rmm.example.com/hooks/nightwatch.
error_webhook_https: HTTPS only — tick the opt-in above if this receiver really has to be reached over plain HTTP.
error_webhook_scheme: Only https:// and http:// can be called.
error_create: The mailbox could not be created. The address may already be connected, or NIGHTWATCH_SECRET_KEY is not set.
